description_en: Deletes available employees from an invoice title
description_zh: 删除发票抬头可用员工
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen invoice-rule-delete --third-part-id 340049 --del-all false --entities entity_type=1 entity_id=12345 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvoiceRuleDelete

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all applicable entities. When del_all is set to true, all entities under the invoice title are deleted, and the entity list parameter is not validated
parameters.help_zh: 删除所有适用人员，当del_all=true时，删除抬头下所有实体，不会校验实体列表参数
parameters.name: del_all

fields.help_en: The entity type of the available scope
fields.name: entity_type

fields.help_en: The entity ID, which can be an employee ID, department ID, role ID, or third-party department ID
fields.help_zh: 实体id：人员id，部门id，角色id，第三方部门id
fields.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: Not required when del_all is set to true. Otherwise, this parameter is required
parameters.name: entities

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" operation. Add it to the header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
